Class SecurityLookupService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.lookup.SecurityLookupService
@Service public class SecurityLookupService extends Object
Proposes the data of a security that is being created from ISIN, currency, exchange and the asset class the user chose. It searches the data providers that cover the chosen type at that exchange, fetches the master data of every listing that does not contradict the query, and offers per feed the connectors that can serve the listing - each with the URL extension the connector derives itself and the outcome of a trial request.

The asset class is the user's choice and is not derived: a region read from the provider data would be wrong for every fifth to third security. The type the provider reports serves as a plausibility check instead; a listing whose type contradicts the choice is flagged, not dropped.

Nothing is written: the probes run on a transient security that is never saved, and the user copies the chosen values into the security form, which is saved through the normal dialog and its validation. Every provider and every probe runs under a deadline; a failure becomes a status and never discards the results of the others.

SIX, Deutsche Börse (Xetra, Frankfurt), Wiener Börse, Euronext, Yahoo, EODHD (with an API key), onvista, Boursorama, Consorsbank, BIVA and Nasdaq Nordic (only for their stock exchange hyperlink) and OpenFIGI are searched (LOOKUP_PROVIDERS), each only when it covers the exchange and the chosen type - decided by the price connector of the same data source (ISecuritySearchProvider.getFeedConnectorShortId()) or by the provider itself; only listings on the queried exchange in the queried currency are kept, the currency of a Yahoo listing being confirmed by its master data. The same listing found by several providers is merged by LookupListingMerger; OpenFIGI only supplements it, e.g. with the ticker of a Frankfurt listing. The connectors offered are not limited to these providers: DivvyDiary, for example, needs only the ISIN.

What the lookup cannot resolve is reported as hints (LookupHints): providers that found the instrument only on another exchange, failed providers, and fields of a listing that no provider delivered.

  • Method Details

    • lookup

      public SecurityLookupResponse lookup(String isin, String currency, String mic, String ticker, Integer idAssetClass, Locale locale)
      Looks up the listings of an instrument.
      Parameters:
      isin - ISIN of the instrument; must be syntactically valid
      currency - trading currency
      mic - MIC of the exchange the security is created on
      ticker - ticker entered in the form, may be null; a fallback search term for providers that know an ISIN only for another listing
      idAssetClass - asset class chosen in the form
      locale - language of the user, used for links to pages offered in several languages
      Returns:
      candidates and the status of every provider that was asked
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the asset class does not exist
